openings.claim: Return to home screen plus communicated visitor language choice makes menu state, requested language and battery joint readiness conditions; removing inherited state and shortening navigation depends on reliable reset and selection.
openings.discriminator: Pair outperforms reset alone, choice alone and incumbent on matched requests if inherited state causes delays.
openings.probe: Compare all four conditions; measure correct-language playback within 60 seconds and average return time. Stop above 30 seconds; check reset effects on charge indication and admission overlap.
openings.uncertainty: Untested synthetic evidence; independent submenu effect, reset reliability, charge-indicator effects and queue overlap unknown. Choice must remain transient.

openings.claim: Language-specific dock positions plus visible setting checks align location cues with actual menu settings; fewer wrong-language handoffs depends on accurate cues and admission capacity.
openings.discriminator: Pair beats grouping alone under equal and uneven language demand; uneven demand could erase benefit.
openings.probe: Compare pair with grouping alone under both demand patterns; measure language errors, timely playback and return time. Stop for delayed admission, retained history or mean returns above 30 seconds.
openings.uncertainty: Untested; marking existing dock positions and checking settings without consuming admission capacity remain assumptions.

lineage.reason: Paired dependency, component comparisons and return-time gate preserved.
Cue-verification dependency, uneven-demand test and admission/privacy gates preserved.

decision: Retain both as separate untested candidates. Require existing twelve handsets/dock, no added staff, attendant admission responsibility, no identities or persisted listening histories, and mean return handling at most 30 seconds. Target at least 95% correct-language playback within one minute during stipulated entrance period; synthetic fixtures establish no effects.
